about: Head frame of the foundation (기준 캐릭터) runtime, measured by tools/hair/measure-head-frame.cjs (stage 3, H1). Generated; do not edit. Read by the hair conversion (H2) and the hair checks (H4).
units: head-native: the head painting's 32x40 frame (user space of FRONT_HAIR_CLIP and HEAD_NECK_CUT), the front view before the bow warp; y down; the head's size differs per view (VIEW_HEAD), so 1 unit = <sex>.<view>.frame.pxPerUnit280 px at 280 px (front 4.676; m right 5.359, m back 5.658, f right 4.676, f back 5.022)

render.handMask: any alpha of the raised hands layer hides the body there
render.paint: fresh: the runtime paint pool (QPFoundationSkin) is emptied before every pose
render.rays: steps of at most half a pixel with a 3x3 maximum test, read every .005 where the edge may be

poses.note: the same list in every view (direction = the view); actions are tools/foundation-matrix.cjs actionState (time k*.2, seated breathing offset removed); idle/breath is idle at the standing breath's peak (time pi/rate); gestures at progress k/36, at time 0 (<gesture>/<k>) and at the breath's peak (<gesture>@breath/<k>)

outlines.note: the front poses' body outlines (keys in front.poses): runs of [x,y,x,y,...], the top edge per .05 column (null between runs); Douglas-Peucker within 0.005 of the measured value, vertices rounded to .01, so linear interpolation gives every grid value within .01 (the products above are exact to .01). The other views and kinds per pose (collar, arms, neck): --raw <file>

bob.clip: FRONT_HAIR_CLIP.f of avatar-foundation.js, as bowFace() draws it in each pose

recorded.source: avatar-foundation.js FRONT_HAIR_CLIP comment (2026-10-08, round 2); rule: 아바타-제작기준.md rule 5

neckColumns.note: the body's neck columns of the 2026-10-08 measurement; the shirt's collar point steps up at the right edge

method2026.reading: the 2026-10-08 script ported unchanged (pageLib bob2026): torso part only, 40 px per viewBox unit, boundary sampled at tenths of its segments, neck columns skipped; idle/0 and the time-0 nod poses, as in 2026-10-08

grid2026.reading: the same reading on the H1 .05 grid: collar outline - boundary outside the neck columns, at grid columns, boundary vertices and the column edges (collar never read across an edge); time-0 poses

corner.note: the nod-peak minimum of the 2026-10-08 reading sits on this edge, one-sided: the collar outline steps up there; drawn: what the front layer draws just above the boundary there (sampled on the render)

rule5.reading: the boundary outside the whole JAW blend (anchoring 1: it stays on the body at every bow depth) over the body outline (collar, sleeves, arms), every front pose (gestures at time 0 and at the breathing peak); rule 5 asks >= 0.1

hair.reading: the rule-5 reading only where the front layer draws hair just above the boundary (sampled on the render, idle/0 and the time-0 nod poses; skin: r >= 170, g/r > .70, b/g > .80); skinAt*: columns outside the JAW blend where it draws face skin there instead (the bowed face slides down over the boundary)
